comment: The escalation-kind registry: everything known about an escalation KIND in one data file, tunable without a code change (the same config-not-code path as api_services.json). floor = minimum composite director-trust score needed to auto-resolve one of these escalations; 1.0 = NEVER auto-resolved, always the human. Omit 'floor' for a kind whose bar should track the live routine default (JEV_SAFETY_CONFIDENCE + calibration) rather than a pinned number. impact/action are the operator-facing copy embedded in every notification (email + Telegram) for that kind. This file OVERRIDES the built-in defaults per kind and per field; an unreadable or corrupt file falls back to the shipped defaults in core/jev.py and integrations/notify.py, so a broken edit can only restore today's behavior, never weaken a gate silently. A floor outside 0..1 (or non-numeric) is ignored loudly.

unsure safety decision.impact: A worker paused on a genuinely unclear safety call and is waiting on yours.
unsure safety decision.action: Decide from the question above; deny if the case for safety is not clearly made.

owner safety decision.impact: The full Jev decision chain could not decide; the action has not run.
owner safety decision.action: Read the command/code above. Approve only if it is ordinary, in-scope work; deny if it is unsafe, destructive, or unjustified.

blocked command.impact: The command did NOT run -- the assigned task may be stalled waiting on it.
blocked command.action: Approve only if you recognize this exact command and want it run; otherwise deny and the worker should find another approach.

blocked pipeline step.impact: The pipeline step did NOT run -- the delivery it belongs to is held up.
blocked pipeline step.action: Approve only if the step is the one you expect from this card; otherwise deny.

blocked browser action.impact: The browser action was refused -- the investigation either adapted or stalled on it.
blocked browser action.action: Approve only if the page/action is clearly in scope; otherwise deny.

unresolved review requirement.impact: A review requirement could not be resolved by the team -- the card is waiting.
unresolved review requirement.action: Approve the resolution described if it genuinely addresses the requirement; else deny so it goes back for real work.

allowlist request.impact: Agent research on this host is waiting on this decision. Meanwhile the host still works through the normal per-request Jev gate (each visit judged individually) -- work is slowed, not stopped. Approving grants standing read+write reachability for sandbox scripts too.
allowlist request.action: If the domain is an ordinary public source that fits the stated purpose, approve; deny otherwise. Denying is safe -- agents keep using the per-request gate.

allowlist candidate.impact: This host earned confident Jev approvals repeatedly; approving makes that standing permanent (full read+write reach for sandbox scripts). Until then every visit re-runs Jev.
allowlist candidate.action: Approve for routine public sources with a clean history; deny if the host's standing has changed.

dormancy window request.impact: The self-edit lander is waiting for a dormancy slot -- no code has been applied yet.
dormancy window request.action: Approve only if the requested window and reason are legitimate and the edits were reviewed; otherwise deny so the change is re-planned.

personnel_strike.impact: A firing strike is on record for this agent -- no personnel action was taken automatically.
personnel_strike.action: Read the cited reports first; this is informational unless you act on it.
